name: known_good_generic_structure_regression
purpose: Generic structural fixture for PIE 0.1 known-good restoration: compact durable responsibility grouping without K1-K7 machinery or source-shaped scaffolding.
natural_request: 请把这个 ChatGPT Project 的长期 instructions 整理成可以直接替换的完整版本。只做当前必要的长期规则整理；保留已有授权、隐私、安全、证据和事实来源边界；把易变细节放回权威来源；不要顺手增加历史事故、最佳实践或示例清单。
live_setting_summary: Three duplicated answer-delivery sections govern the same normal trigger: conclusion first, user action next, evidence after that.
One distinct closure-report rule applies only when formally closing a delivery task.
A broad production authorization boundary is live: all production mutations require explicit current-task authorization for object, purpose, and scope.
A narrower client-channel rule is also live and has the same authorization consequence.
The same mutable supported integration set appears in two live sections, while docs/current-integrations.md owns membership.
Live setting preserves privacy, current-evidence, fail-closed, uncertainty, and exact-identity requirements.
targeted_history_summary: A historical authentication incident is mentioned but is not in the live setting.
A historical-only broad rule absent from the live setting is mentioned for contrast.
A previous auto-send-beta-summary rule was explicitly rejected and is absent from the live setting.
